_source: NWS County Warning Area and county layers of the NWS Reference Maps service, queried 2026-10-17 (AWIPS files w_16ap26 and c_16ap26): https://mapservices.weather.noaa.gov/static/rest/services/nws_reference_maps/nws_reference_map/MapServer (layer 1 gives each forecast office's region, layer 2 each county's office).
_method: Each state is assigned the region that runs most of its forecast offices. 'counties' lists the counties whose office belongs to a different region. A county shared by two offices (NWS codes like GJTSLC) goes with the first office listed.

ER._note: GA counties served by Columbia (CAE), Charleston (CHS) and Greenville-Spartanburg (GSP); IN and KY counties served by Wilmington OH (ILN) and Charleston WV (RLX)

SR._note: MO counties served by Memphis (MEG); NC and VA counties served by Morristown TN (MRX)

CR._note: OH counties served by Northern Indiana (IWX); UT counties served by Grand Junction (GJT)

WR._note: WY counties served by Billings (BYZ) and Salt Lake City (SLC)
